how to improve the quality of Master of Education by strengthening the cultivation features of practical orientation and academic training.

the cultivation model of Master of Education should combine practical training and academic training together, and the cultivation of Master of Education would be more practical, applicable and professional.
the cultivation of Master of Education should be based on the practical orientation and be guided by the academic orientation.
